URL-encode each festival slug or lunar-photo identifier as a single path/fragment component. Trusted existing identifiers retain their original destinations; arbitrary delimiters cannot create a different path or fragment.

Retained countdown fingerprint. sourcePath comes solely from the checked-in official event catalog. Every destination is an audited local page or HTTPS primary source. Visitor-created countdown names are not this catalog field. Current countdown source already parses the URL and permits only same-origin or HTTPS links.

ShoppingGuides reads generated, version-controlled HTML from data/shopping-html for a path selected by the static DATA.paths catalog. There is no visitor/admin-supplied HTML or user-controlled file path. The authored SVG, JSON data island and module scripts are intended build inputs. Generator and shopping-guide validation tests cover these sources.

Retained horoscope v1 adapter. rising.slug is one of twelve server-rendered zodiac profile identifiers, selected by a calculated numeric index. A fixed /horoskop/ prefix keeps the result a same-origin path. Current v2 additionally validates the alphabetic slug. No script scheme or HTML sink is involved.

URL.createObjectURL receives a locally created calendar Blob. The call supplies text/calendar and a .ics download filename; JSON backups use application/json and .json. The anchor has download set before clicking. No remote or javascript URL is accepted, and no HTML is inserted.

Non-executable application/json school data comes from a checked-in file. Every < is replaced by a literal JSON Unicode escape before raw, so </script cannot close the data island. Dedicated regression verifies hostile closing-script content remains data.

JSON is deliberately embedded as a non-executable application/json data island. Rails ERB::Util.json_escape encodes <, >, &, U+2028 and U+2029 before raw. The source is version-controlled garden/education data. Closing-script and entity injection are covered by a dedicated rendering regression.

The source is a synthetic test-only password in PlannerIntegrationTest, passed to Admin.create! password=. has_secure_password hashes it with bcrypt into password_digest. It is not persisted as plaintext. The regression verifies password changes revoke other test sessions.

Resolve requested download names by exact hash lookup into catalog-owned Pathname objects. The filesystem path is built only from trusted catalog values, checked under site/, never from request.path. Regression verifies traversal variants do not resolve.

The SARIF source is the public numeric LONGITUDE_TOLERANCE_DEG constant, not a private coordinate or user record. The sink writes an intentionally public scientific ephemeris validation report. It contains public JPL/USNO comparisons and tolerance values.
